rules.headline: Recorded penicillin-class allergy
rules.rationale: The patient has a recorded allergy to the same drug class as this medication.
limitations: Class-level check only; this is not a guideline recommendation.
Evidence citation pending: no source has been linked to this rule in this release.
Reaction type, severity and date determine real-world significance.

rules.headline: Recorded penicillin allergy — possible cross-reactivity (needs review)
rules.rationale: A recorded penicillin-class allergy may or may not imply reaction to this related drug; cross-reactivity depends on the original reaction and the drugs' structures, so no blanket conclusion is drawn.
limitations: Class-level check only; this is not a guideline recommendation.
